source_system: Change tickets (20 sampled); payments hub configuration log (10 limit changes); change advisory board minutes; Director of Payments Operations interview
what_it_shows: 20 of 20 sampled infrastructure and application changes were reviewed, approved and recorded by the change advisory board; payments hub business configuration is not designated as configuration-controlled; 10 of 10 sampled limit changes had no review before implementation and no documented approval, and were recorded only in the application log; configuration change activity in the payments hub is not reviewed

title: Control assessment: configuration settings
source_system: Cloud posture reports; benchmark scans of 10 servers; build sheets
what_it_shows: Cloud accounts run under guardrails with daily posture checks; settings for on-premises servers are not documented against a benchmark, and the 10 scanned servers scored 61% to 78% against it; deviations and drift on on-premises servers are not identified or monitored

title: Control assessment: system component inventory
source_system: Device management, cloud inventory and network discovery reports; reconciliation of 20 components sampled from the network
what_it_shows: Inventories from device management, the cloud and network discovery are reconciled monthly; all 20 components sampled from the network were in the inventory

title: Control assessment: contingency plan
source_system: Business continuity plan (2025); BIA (P05); 2025 failover test report; COO, CIO and Correspondent Services Director interviews
what_it_shows: The 2025 plan identifies essential functions, restoration priorities, metrics, responsibilities and contacts, and is reviewed, approved and protected; recovery objectives for correspondent services and the item processing servers, roles for the payments hub failover, reconciliation of in-flight wires and sharing with respondent institutions are not in the plan; it does not reference the incident response plan; it is not distributed to correspondent operations; it was not updated after the 2025 failover test

title: Control assessment: contingency plan testing
source_system: 2025 failover test report; core processor DR test letter; CIO interview
what_it_shows: The payments hub failover was last tested in 2025-05 and took 9 hours against a 4-hour RTO; no success criteria were defined and no corrective actions were opened; the secondary wire room was not tested for correspondent volume; test results were reviewed by the CIO and the COO

title: Control assessment: system backup
source_system: Backup job reports (31 of 31 July days); vault lock settings; test deletion attempt by a production administrator
what_it_shows: Backup jobs completed on 31 of 31 days in July 2026; write-once retention is set; a deletion attempt on a test backup by a production administrator was blocked

title: Control assessment: recovery and reconstitution
source_system: Recovery runbooks; 2025 failover test report
what_it_shows: Recovery of the payments hub within the 4-hour RTO has not been demonstrated (9 hours in 2025); reconstitution steps (reconciliation, re-enabling the Federal Reserve connection) are not written

title: Control assessment: MFA for privileged accounts
source_system: Conditional access policy; MFA sign-in tests on 25 of 41 privileged accounts in the directory, identity provider and cloud
what_it_shows: MFA with a hardware key was required for all 25 sampled privileged sign-ins

title: Control assessment: authenticator management
source_system: Password policies for the identity provider and the core; correspondent portal account list; test sign-in with the vendor default password pattern
what_it_shows: The identity provider enforces 14-character passwords and the core allows 8-character passwords; 2 vendor-created generic administrator accounts in the correspondent portal accepted the vendor default password pattern; their initial authenticators were set by the vendor and were not changed when vendor implementation staff left; reported to the ISO and the CRO on 2026-08-12 and disabled on 2026-08-14

title: Control assessment: customer identification and authentication
source_system: Digital banking provider MFA enrollment report; admin console settings; test of adding a beneficiary with a relayed one-time code in the provider test environment
what_it_shows: 12% of business users use SMS codes and consumers get a code only on new devices; in the provider test environment a relayed one-time code allowed a new beneficiary to be added

title: Control assessment: identity proofing for contact changes
source_system: Account maintenance procedure; 40 business contact-information changes sampled (April to June 2026); test call requesting a phone number change
what_it_shows: Account opening follows the customer identification program; 11 of 40 sampled contact-information changes had no verification evidence; a test call using public information persuaded an agent to start a phone number change, which was stopped before it was saved

title: Control assessment: incident handling
source_system: Incident register; BSA case system; 10 of 31 incidents sampled; 2025 tabletop report
what_it_shows: The MSSP and IT detected, contained and recovered from all 10 sampled security incidents; fraud events and security incidents are handled in separate systems with different scope (fraud cases include no log review or containment in online banking); lessons from fraud cases are not added to incident procedures; incident handling is not coordinated with the continuity plan

title: Control assessment: incident reporting
source_system: Incident response plan (2024); interviews with 15 staff on reporting; CEO and ISO interviews
what_it_shows: 13 of 15 interviewed staff knew the 1-hour reporting rule and the incident line; the plan has no criteria for the notification incident determination, no Federal Reserve notice for the holding company and no notice to respondent institutions

title: Control assessment: incident response plan
source_system: Incident response plan (2024); distribution list; P08 runbook drafts
what_it_shows: The 2024 plan sets the roadmap, structure, approach, resources, information sharing, approval and responsibilities; it does not address the bank as a service provider to respondents, does not define notification incidents by criteria and sets no response metrics; it is not distributed to branch managers, correspondent operations or the MSSP in its current version; it was not updated after the 2025 core processor outage; changes were not communicated to the crisis management team; the draft P08 runbooks were reviewed

title: Control assessment: nonlocal maintenance
source_system: Vendor VPN configuration and logs; payments hub vendor support sessions (10 of 46 in July 2026 sampled)
what_it_shows: Vendor sessions use named accounts with MFA; sessions are not approved individually, monitored in real time or recorded; records are limited to VPN connection logs; 3 of 10 sampled sessions stayed connected overnight; the connection is always on

title: Control assessment: risk management strategy
source_system: Enterprise risk appetite statement (2025); Board Risk Committee minutes; P01 draft tolerances
what_it_shows: The 2025 appetite statement has no measurable cyber tolerances; privacy risk is covered and the strategy is reviewed each year; AI tools were adopted outside the risk process; the draft P01 tolerances were reviewed

title: Control assessment: personnel termination
source_system: HR separation list; 25 of 142 terminations sampled; badge and core records
what_it_shows: Core access was disabled 1 to 6 business days after the last day for 9 of 25 sampled terminations; credential revocation, exit interviews, return of property and retention of records were evidenced for all 25

title: Control assessment: risk assessment
source_system: P01 register and report; 2025 risk assessment; Board Risk Committee minutes
what_it_shows: The 2025 risk assessment and the P01 register and report (2026-07-24) identify threats and vulnerabilities, rate likelihood and impact, and are documented, reviewed, shared with the Board Risk Committee and updated each year

title: Control assessment: vulnerability monitoring and scanning
source_system: Monthly scan reports (January to June 2026); remediation metrics; 50 of 212 critical findings sampled
what_it_shows: Monthly authenticated scans ran from January to June 2026 and results were analyzed and shared; 9 of 50 sampled critical findings on on-premises servers were remediated after the 30-day target (18%)

title: Control assessment: external system services
source_system: Contracts for 34 critical vendors; SOC review files; 53.4 contact letters
what_it_shows: 9 of 34 critical vendor contracts set no incident notice time frame; user entity responsibilities (CUECs) are defined only for the core processor; SOC reports are collected without exception follow-up for 26 of 34 critical vendors

title: Control assessment: unsupported system components
source_system: Server inventory; segment rules; Infrastructure Manager interview
what_it_shows: 14 item processing servers run an unsupported operating system on an isolated segment; no extended support option was sought

title: Control assessment: boundary protection
source_system: Firewall and security group rules; network diagrams; reachability test from a branch teller segment to the payments segment
what_it_shows: Boundary and internal interfaces are monitored and controlled through managed firewalls and deny-by-default rules; the reachability test from a branch teller segment to the payments segment was blocked

title: Control assessment: flaw remediation
source_system: Patch compliance reports; 50 critical findings sampled
what_it_shows: Flaws are identified, reported and corrected, with updates tested before installation; security-relevant software updates were installed after the 30-day target on 18% of on-premises servers in the first half of 2026; firmware updates were within target

title: Control assessment: malicious code protection
source_system: EDR console report; test files on 5 endpoints and 2 servers
what_it_shows: EDR is active on all managed endpoints and servers; it detected and quarantined every test file within 4 minutes

title: Control assessment: system monitoring
source_system: SIEM source and use-case lists; MSSP escalation records (5 sampled); simulated impossible-travel sign-in
what_it_shows: The SIEM monitors identity, endpoint, firewall and cloud sources and the simulated sign-in was escalated in 18 minutes; payments hub, correspondent portal and core security events are not monitored, no use cases cover beneficiary, limit or contact-information changes, and monitoring was not adjusted when the correspondent portal went live

title: Control assessment: supplier assessments and reviews
source_system: SOC review files for 34 critical vendors
what_it_shows: CUEC mapping and exception follow-up are recorded for the core processor and 7 other Tier 1 vendors reviewed in 2026, and not for the other critical vendors
